title: Tsou language - Wikipedia
text: Tsou has traditionally been considered part of a Tsouic branch of Austronesian. However, several recent classifications, such as Chang (2006) [5] and Ross (2009) [6] dispute the Tsouic branch, with Tsou more divergent than the other two languages, Kanakanabu and Saaroa.

title: Tsou people - Wikipedia
text: The Tsou (Tsou: Cou; Chinese: 鄒; pinyin: Zōu; Wade–Giles: Tsou) are an indigenous people of central southern Taiwan. They are an Austronesian ethnic group. They reside in Chiayi County and Nantou County.
